'''''Transient Persons''''' was the name of a file hidden in the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] banks at [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]]. It contained a list of all prisoners being secretly held by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] in the Stars' End facility.
